original.prompt: In December 2025, Stage IV of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) was invoked in Delhi-NCR. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It was invoked after Delhi's Air Quality Index breached 450 and slid into the 'Severe+' band.
Construction and demolition were halted across Delhi-NCR, but public works were exempted.
Offices were pushed to have roughly 50% of staff work from home.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the Stage IV halt on construction and demolition covered public works too. Stage IV, the toughest curbs under GRAP, also barred non-essential trucks and many diesel goods vehicles from Delhi.
original.source: All construction and demolition across Delhi-NCR stops, including public works.

rewritten.prompt: In December 2025, Stage IV of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) was invoked in Delhi-NCR. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It was invoked after Delhi's Air Quality Index breached 450 and slid into the 'Severe+' band.
Construction and demolition were halted across Delhi-NCR, with public works included in the halt.
Offices were pushed to have roughly 50% of staff work from home.
rewritten.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
rewritten.explain: All three statements are correct: Stage IV followed AQI breaching 450 in the 'Severe+' band, halted all construction and demolition including public works, and pushed offices to roughly 50% work from home. Stage IV, the toughest curbs under GRAP, also barred non-essential trucks and many diesel goods vehicles from Delhi.
rewritten.source: All construction and demolition across Delhi-NCR stops, including public works.
